task_notes.02: cbe1585: shared rollback refuses missing/nested transactions and checks transaction identity after finalization before undo. MCP asset edits refuse active transactions and PIE; diagnostics remain usable. Full dependent-widget loss is not reproduced or certified fixed.
task_notes.05: cbe1585: ordinary call-function readers and spawners share Function|reflected-path IDs. Blueprint function identities normalize skeleton/generated classes through the owning asset. Existing display IDs remain accepted when unambiguous. Duplicate graph references no longer produce false ambiguity. Inline expressions, specialized/custom nodes and whole reader/write round-trip remain open.
task_notes.06: cbe1585: Tidy uses SGraphEditor measured bounds in its plan rather than requiring stored K2 node dimensions. No node-size mutation during measurement. Adds macro/event graph enumeration and refuses ambiguous graph names. Visual overlap and all target-only layout guarantees remain unverified; truly headless sizing remains unsupported.
task_notes.07: Source batch prevents nested script writes through the protected plugin registry and warns compile does not prove reachability. No new execution-chain analysis or runtime proof; task stays open.
task_notes.08: cbe1585: status includes engine version, module binary path and file timestamp, explicitly not source-revision proof; reports source revision unknown. Help flags PlayCheck execution effects and directs truncated summaries to the full tool index. Exact embedded source revision and pagination remain open.
task_notes.09: cbe1585: NodeResolve includes stable pin category/subcategory/container and object/text defaults. NodeFind result cap now applies across all graphs. Remaining schema authoring features are not implemented.

notes.02: b0753f2 removes explicit CompileBlueprint and structural marking from Append/Patch/Replace edit transactions. These tools now mark modified and report compile=not_run; explicit compile/save are separate. Apply also refuses PIE/nested transactions directly. This closes identified plugin compile-in-transaction paths, not every dependent-widget loss cause.
notes.03: b0753f2 removes raw pin assignment before Modify in Append/Patch. K2 defaults are parsed/validated before mutation; undo captured first; post-callback pin identity/default read-back required. Linked/read-only/output/exec/orphaned pins refuse literal writes.
notes.04: b0753f2 checks rollback return values and returns failure on graph node-set mismatch. Replace preflights destructive targets before append. Replacement remains two-phase and can retain the append if removals fail; report labels this partial rather than unchanged.
notes.05: b0753f2 unifies graph lookup with the reader and rejects ambiguous graph names in Append/Patch/Replace. Replace checks removal identity and graph node count before any append.
